sloka: उष्यतां चेह रजनी सकाशे मम राघव ।प्रभाते पुष्पकेण त्वं गन्ता ऽसि पुरमेव हि ।। ७.७६.२८ ॥
transliteration: uṣyatāṁ ceha rajanī sakāśe mama rāghava ।prabhāte puṣpakeṇa tvaṁ gantā 'si purameva hi ।। 7.76.28 ॥

translations.english: O scion of Raghu, please stay here for the night near me, and in the morning, you will certainly go to your city by the Pushpaka chariot.
